grammar_contract.input: An actual parse-that ParserState at any source-native UTF-16 offset from 0 through source.length.
grammar_contract.operation: Inspect the next at-most-three positions and return true exactly for sign+digit, sign+dot+digit, dot+digit, or digit; otherwise false.
grammar_contract.consumption: The Parser<boolean> always succeeds, replaces state.value with one boolean, consumes zero code units, and preserves offset, furthest, expected, suggestions, and secondarySpans exactly.
grammar_contract.diagnostic_sandbox: Candidate recognition must use direct parse-that terminals/combinators. A candidate-local Parser wrapper may snapshot and restore parse-that error bookkeeping around speculative recognition; it may not inspect state.src, classify characters, consume input, or feed a token stream. This is a state-isolation adapter, not a terminal/scanner waiver.
grammar_contract.preprocessing: The positive alphabet is only ASCII +, -, ., and digits. CSS preprocessing changes no positive case; NUL, CR, CRLF, FF, lone surrogates, scalar astral code points, and other non-ASCII inputs remain false in every inspected position. Public fixtures exercise each class and nonzero source-native offsets.
grammar_contract.diagnostics: No new diagnostic state on true or false. The harness seeds nonempty error bookkeeping and requires exact preservation.
grammar_contract.recovery: Not applicable: the operation consumes nothing, always succeeds, and cannot throw for a string input.
grammar_contract.work_bound: O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space after input existence; grammar recognition examines no more than three positions and materializes no token, CST, substring, or array proportional to source length.

benchmark.semantic_precheck: Before timing, every candidate must match every public, deterministic-hostile, and revealed-holdout observation at root and nonzero offsets, preserve seeded diagnostics, and parse each downstream sentinel from the unchanged offset.
benchmark.timed_operation: For one prevalidated case, construct ParserState with the case offset and seeded diagnostic state, then call the exact candidate parser. Do not assert, normalize, stringify, or compare inside timing.
benchmark.corpus: Exact public case IDs and deterministic hostile outputs; revealed holdout joins after candidate close.
benchmark.schedule: Interleaved paired permutation over candidate IDs with fixed xoshiro256** seed 0x564e554d53544152; identical case index and invocation count per pair.
benchmark.statistics: Raw nanoseconds, median, MAD, and geometric mean paired ratios. Strict win requires the one-sided 95% percentile-bootstrap upper endpoint over paired log-ratios, 10000 fixed-seed resamples, below 0.
benchmark.allocation: Report allocation evidence when exposed; otherwise UNAVAILABLE with exact runtime/tool reason.
